title: Plasmoids on the desktop should use KWin's Blur effect and settings
line: Desktop widget backgrounds now use the blur strength set for KWin's Blur effect, like panels and popups.
explanation: Desktop widgets aren't windows, so KWin can't blur behind them; the desktop containment blurs the wallpaper itself in QML with a fixed, maximum radius. Changing the Blur strength in System Settings therefore changed panels and popups but never desktop widgets, and the Blur settings page didn't even send a change notification for it. KWin's Blur settings page now writes BlurStrength with KConfig::Notify, and the containment's background helper follows it through KConfigWatcher, mapping each of KWin's 15 strengths to the reach of its dual Kawase blur; the default strength keeps today's look.

commits.message:
plugins/blur: notify when the blur strength changes

The Blur settings page wrote BlurStrength without a change notification,
so only KWin, which the page asks to reconfigure, noticed the new value.
Write it with KConfig::Notify, so Plasma can match its desktop widgets.

BUG: 512579

containmentlayoutmanager: follow KWin's blur strength on widgets

Desktop widgets aren't windows, so they blur the wallpaper on their own
and always used the strongest blur, whatever strength is set for KWin's
Blur effect. Read that strength from kwinrc and match the widget blur.

BUG: 512579

The Blur settings page wrote BlurStrength without a change notification,

BUG: 512579
---
 src/plugins/blur/blurconfig.kcfgc | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/src/plugins/blur/blurconfig.kcfgc b/src/plugins/blur/blurconfig.kcfgc

--- a/src/plugins/blur/blurconfig.kcfgc

@@ -3,3 +3,4 @@ ClassName=BlurConfig
 NameSpace=KWin
 Singleton=true
 Mutators=true
+Notifiers=BlurStrength
